I can cope with these lesions but what I cant cope with is the horrendous itchy skin where the tracts from these lesions connect under the skin. I used to use aloe vera gel to try to calm the itch but it wasnt very successful. When I first saw the bath crystals I thought that it might not work as I have tried a number of things to stop the itching, but gave it a go. I am so impressed the itch has stopped and although it has not stopped the lesions I feel so much better as I can get to sleep without having to scratch so much it took the skin off.
